name: Steam
description: Sign in with the Steam Mobile App to read your library, achievements and game updates in Persona, with optional wishlist alerts for deals, releases and demos. A Web API key is also available for public data.

auth_mode.title: Sign-in method
auth_mode.description: Defaults to Steam Mobile QR. Existing settings with a player ID and Web API key continue to use the key.

steam_id.title: Steam player ID
steam_id.description: For Web API key mode. Enter your 17-digit SteamID64 or the vanity name from your Steam profile URL.

country_code.title: Store country or region
country_code.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 country or region code for wishlist prices and currency. Defaults to US.

inbox_events_enabled.title: Steam Inbox events
inbox_events_enabled.description: Check the wishlist automatically and alert you to deals, releases and demos. Turning this off stops background checks and uses zero extra AI tokens.

inbox_max_events_per_day.title: Daily Steam Inbox event limit
inbox_max_events_per_day.description: Maximum number of new Steam Inbox events per UTC day. Range 1–50, default 5.

wishlist_event_triggers.title: Wishlist alert triggers
wishlist_event_triggers.description: Choose discount, local_low, release, demo and giveaway alerts. The same price in a sale or an already announced release or demo version is reported once.

wishlist_discount_threshold.title: Wishlist discount threshold (%)
wishlist_discount_threshold.description: Alert when the discount reaches this percentage. Range 1–100, default 50.

wishlist_target_prices.title: Wishlist target prices
wishlist_target_prices.description: Optional. Separate up to 20 rules with commas in AppID:CURRENCY:Steam price units format. For example, 123:USD:999 means $9.99.

patch_notes_summary_enabled.title: AI summaries of major updates
patch_notes_summary_enabled.description: Share short announcement excerpts with the assistant for summaries. Off by default, with headlines, dates, sources and links available.

sale_roundup_enabled.title: Wishlist sale roundups
sale_roundup_enabled.description: When at least three wishlist games are discounted, replace their individual price alerts with one roundup. Requires Steam Inbox events. Off by default.

memory_export_enabled.title: Export gaming preferences to assistant memory
memory_export_enabled.description: Share personal gaming preferences through memory_sources. Loading them into the assistant uses context tokens. Off by default.

memory_max_items.title: Gaming preference export limit
memory_max_items.description: Maximum number of personal gaming preference items exported when memory export is enabled. Range 1–30, default 10.

discovery_tools_enabled.title: Steam game research tools and skill
discovery_tools_enabled.description: Allow game research tools and their skill to add detailed results to the assistant's context. Turn this off to disable those research features. On by default.

discovery_max_results.title: Game research result limit
discovery_max_results.description: Maximum number of candidates per search or research request when game research is enabled. Range 1–50, default 15.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API key
steam_api_key.description: For Web API key mode. The Hub encrypts the key, and the extension sends it only to api.steampowered.com.
